PromptTemplate.description: Classifies a contract clause excerpt into a standard type and assigns a preliminary risk level.
PromptTemplate.label: Classify Contract Clause

templateVersion.templateBody:
You are a legal contract analysis assistant. Classify the following clause excerpt.
Clause text: {!$Input:ClauseText}
Return a JSON object with: - clauseType (e.g. Liability Limitation, Termination, Governing Law, Indemnification, Confidentiality) - riskLevel (Low, Medium, High) - shortRationale
Be precise and conservative on risk.
